title: dns: validate SVCB parameter lengths and resynchronize parsing
description:
This MR improves validation of SVCB/HTTPS SvcParam parsing in `packet-dns.c`.

While testing malformed HTTPS RR inputs, I found a few cases where invalid SvcParam lengths could cause parsing to drift into subsequent parameters or skip RFC validation checks.

This change adds:

* stricter SvcParam length validation
* bounds checks for parameter parsing
* malformed Expert Info reporting
* consistent parser resynchronization after malformed parameters

It also adds key-specific validation for:\
`mandatory`, `port`, `ipv4hint`, `ipv6hint`, `no-default-alpn`, `ohttp`, and `alpn`.

Example:\
`no-default-alpn` with a non-zero length is now correctly flagged as malformed instead of allowing misaligned parsing of following parameters.

Tested locally with crafted malformed HTTPS RR packets. A sample capture is attached for reproduction/testing.

[dns-https-svcparam-invalid-length.pcap](/uploads/8aa6f8323371da642d6fd42ae383a5ad/dns-https-svcparam-invalid-length.pcap)
